description: Months of cash runway for a startup, either from a monthly net burn ("burn" mode) or from monthly revenue and expenses with growth rates ("pl" mode), including the break-even month and whether the company is default alive within 10 years. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/runway-calculator

burn_growth_pct.description: Burn mode: month-over-month change in burn, percent (2 = +2% a month).

expense_growth_pct.description: P&L mode: month-over-month expense growth, percent.

mode.description: "burn": give monthly net burn. "pl": give monthly revenue and expenses.

monthly_burn_usd.description: Burn mode: monthly net burn (cash out minus cash in).

revenue_growth_pct.description: P&L mode: month-over-month revenue growth, percent.

name: runway
title: Startup runway calculator
